provenance.source_first_species_rule: Joachimmarien/MOSA public 2_markdown Processing data.Rmd: ID=unique(MN$TOE); character=rbind(character,ID2[1,4:12]); then character$SPECIES!='MN' exclusion

interpretation.main: First-retained capture species plausibly explains why 18 raw MN codes are present as species unknown and two codes were initially assigned another species, without relabeling any animal.
interpretation.whitespace: Fourteen author encounter rows have different literal TOE text but collide after trimming whitespace. Matrix row count is not biological individual count.
interpretation.unresolved: One raw MN code remains missing from author MN despite a first retained MN label; seven author MN codes have no uncorrected author-date source record; exact published manual deletion/correction replay is necessary.
interpretation.hold: The displayed counts do not resolve published 19,850 individuals from 19,818 distinct raw MN TOE codes, nor prove tag-unique animals.
interpretation.source_reuse_caveat: The first-retained-date projection deliberately omitted the author's one 2004 date correction and explicit deleted-date series; a separate exact replay is underway.
